title: A world model of the virtual cell.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: Europe PMC reports no open-access full text, no PMCID, no supplement, no text-mined accessions, no NCBI links (GEO/SRA/BioProject) and no Zenodo/Dryad records for the DOI.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: From the abstract only: this is a perspective paper proposing a 'virtual cell world model' framework (architecture, data framework, training strategy, evaluation principles). It does not describe generating or releasing any dataset.

a1_downloadable.note: No dataset exists to download: a conceptual perspective article, paywalled, with no accessions, supplement or repository record found (checked via Europe PMC, NCBI links and Zenodo/Dryad search).

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No data table, so there is no label column; any task would have to be assembled from other people's perturbation datasets.

a3_inputs_present.note: No inputs released; the paper only discusses existing foundation models and data types in general terms.

a6_fits_laptop.note: No data; the framework envisioned (multi-modal, multi-scale cell simulators) would be far beyond a laptop anyway.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No counts in the paper or any repository to compare.

a8_label_provenance.note: No labels exist to trace back to a measurement.

honest_claim_h3: None possible: the paper releases no data, so no model trained on it could claim anything.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use a cell's current molecular state plus an intervention (gene knockout, drug) to predict how the cell changes over time.
plain_idea.train_on: Nothing from this paper: it is an opinion/framework piece with no data; examples would have to come from other public perturbation datasets (count unknown).
plain_idea.predict: Future cell state after an intervention; the true answer would come from other labs' perturbation experiments, not from this paper.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Cell biologists could screen interventions in silico before the wet lab, but this paper supplies only the vision, not data to test it.

ml_idea: None from this paper. A virtual-cell perturbation project would need to start from a data paper (e.g., a released Perturb-seq screen), not this perspective.

effort.cheapest_killing_check: Already done: Europe PMC and NCBI show no data, accessions or supplement for this DOI.

verdict_reason: Perspective paper proposing a conceptual 'virtual cell world model' framework; it releases no dataset, accessions or supplement (verified via Europe PMC, NCBI links, Zenodo/Dryad), so A1 and A2 fail.
